segments.contextAfter: **Stable**: Stable features are features that have recently begun shipping in Safari and are on by default. These feature can be toggled to help determine if a feature is causing an issue, or to make sure your site still gracefully handles the absence of the feature for features not yet shipping in all browsers. Stable features will eventually be removed from the list of feature flags.
